question: Sindhi poet and writer Vasdev Mohi was selected for the Saraswati Samman, 2019. This award is given annually by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**KK Birla Foundation.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Saraswati Samman was instituted in 1991 by the K.K Birla Foundation.**
 
• It is an annual award for prose or poetry literary works in any of the 22 Indian languages listed in Schedule VIII of the Constitution of India.
 
• It consists of Rs 15 lakh, a citation, and a plaque.
 
• **Dr Sharan Kumar Limbale,** former head of Nashik's Yashwantrao Chavan Open University and author of 40 books to his credit, has bagged the** Saraswati Samman 2020.**
 
• **Saraswati Samman 2019** is awarded to a Sindhi writer Vasdev Mohi for his short stories collection named Chequebook.
 
• **K Siva Reddy** received the **Saraswati Award for the year 2018.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• Noted poet and litterateur **Prof Ramdarash Mishra** will be awarded the prestigious **Saraswati Samman, 2021,** for his collection of poems **‘Mein to Yahan Hun’.**
 
• Instituted in 1991, Saraswati Samman is given every year to an outstanding literary work written in any Indian language by an Indian citizen and published within the last 10 yrs. 
 
• It carries a citation, a plaque, and a cash prize of ₹15 lakhs.
 
• The recipient is choosen by a selection committee, whose current head is Dr. Subhash C Kashyap, former secretary-general of the Lok Sabha Secretariat.
